description:
Open the existing T8 housing bracket model and create three specific 3D dimensions using the Draft Workbench: 

1. A Linear Dimension measuring the full Length of the part's base.
2. A Linear Dimension measuring the full Width of the part's base.
3. A Dimension measuring the Diameter of the large central shaft hole.

All dimensions must be colored Red (RGB: 255, 0, 0) for visibility. 

Save the annotated model as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_annotated.FCStd'.
